about_the_game:
Game Introduction

On the ancient Yellowstone continent, a magic with corrupt energy slowly erodes here, and the creatures touched become extremely cruel. However, intelligent creatures increasingly crave the additional power brought by this energy

The protagonist seems to be a "destined person" guided by fate, slowly uncovering the truth of the dark magic of this continent under the guidance of angels.

However, things are not that simple, and the so-called justice on this continent is far from it. Conspiracy has gradually surfaced with the investigation

Gameplay Introduction

This is a very traditional turn based game, where the vast majority of elements in turn based games are included

This game has a linear storyline without any decryption elements, ensuring that players can enjoy the game all the way

The game has a very rich system of props and equipment, including up to 110 dynamic enemies and 80 dynamic bosses with dragon bones, and players can control more than 30 character images

The game has undergone testing and feedback from over 300 players, and is now guaranteed to have almost no bugs

The game includes a set system, inlay system, enchantment system, crafting system, synthesis system, skill learning system, and encyclopedia collection system

Each game allows you to choose 6 professions from 32 to form your team, emphasizing the combination of professions

Ensure that each save has a different gaming experience

In addition to the above gameplay, it also includes farm, ranch and other gameplay!

At present, the game duration can reach up to 50 hours. If you like to play games of the brush brush type, then you will definitely love this game!

Author's words

This game has been in production since 2021, and all the content was independently completed by me. It's finally over, and it's something to be happy about (laughs)

Making games and playing them for everyone has always been my wish, and now it has finally come true. This is also a manifestation of my self-worth, isn't it? (laughs)

Anyway, at least the first step has been taken

Treating this game as if it were my most precious treasure, I will always pay attention to your suggestions and feedback, and promptly fix any bugs

We will also strive to add new gameplay in the future!

Thank you all for your enjoyment!

I hope everyone can have a happy experience with this game

I also wish you good health and a happy life!
